name: Home-services referral pipeline broker
one_liner: Match home-service businesses (painters, siding, contractors) with complementary businesses that can refer jobs to them, using public data and text/email outreach, and charge per intro.
customer: Home-service businesses like painters, siding companies and specialist trades that want steady referral partners
offer: Done-for-you warm introductions to complementary businesses, such as general contractors and luxury home builders, that see the same customers earlier in the job
how_it_makes_money: Paid per intro: started at $150 each, now $6,000 for a 10-intro package. Did $27K last month, up from $14K in June
time_to_first_revenue: weeks (started by doing intros for $150 each)
evidence: "Today, he charges $6,000 for 10 intros... did $27,000 last month" (69eN9vRtWB8)
"He sent one text that got one painter four bids worth $64,000" (69eN9vRtWB8)
Revenue went from $14K in June to $27K in September (69eN9vRtWB8)
Came from seeing a bigger siding firm send hundreds of leads a year to his employer (69eN9vRtWB8)
risks: Pay-per-intro value depends on intro quality, so expect refund or dispute risk
UK trades may be less used to paying for intros, so the offer needs local validation
Relies on outreach volume; strict UK/EU SMS rules (PECR/GDPR) make B2B email or LinkedIn the safer channel

name: Single-service niche lead-gen site with subcontractors
one_liner: Build an SEO site around one high-intent local service keyword and send booked jobs to subcontractors, or sell the leads to local operators.
customer: Homeowners who need a specific job done, such as hoarding cleanup, couch disposal, junk removal or water heater replacement; local trades can also buy the leads
offer: An online booking site for one niche service, with the work done by vetted subcontractors
how_it_makes_money: Margin between the job price and the subcontractor's pay, or a fee per lead. Example jobs: hoarding cleanup up to $20K per job; a single-service water heater business making $700K a year
startup_cost: low (domain, site, SEO time); medium if you add paid ads
evidence: "I book jobs online... send the jobs out to the subcontractors... operate in over 40 cities nationwide" (liw7LVwgGhI)
Hoarding cleanup described as high-ticket, title claims $20,000/job (liw7LVwgGhI)
Water heater replacement: $700K/yr; 112,000 searches/mo, keyword difficulty 0 (US data) (iWmTuDAHl7Q)
risks: The search volume and difficulty figures are for the US, so UK keyword data needs checking separately
Finding reliable subcontractors and controlling quality is hard to do remotely
Google algorithm changes and slow SEO ramp-up
Liability and customer complaints for work you don't control

name: Refurbish and flip free discarded appliances
one_liner: Collect washers and dryers that people throw away for free, fix them with YouTube-learned repairs, and resell them locally.
customer: Budget-conscious local households buying used appliances
offer: Repaired, tested used washers and dryers
how_it_makes_money: Resale at $200 to $1,000+ per unit with near-zero cost of goods. The operator makes $10K+/month
startup_cost: low (~$300/mo garage rental, multimeter, basic tools, van access)
evidence: "makes over $10,000 a month with used... thrown away appliances" (a8P2K9DYJp4)
"sells them for 200 to 1,000 bucks plus"; garage rental $300/mo found on Marketplace (a8P2K9DYJp4)
"He's not technical, he didn't go to appliance repair school" (a8P2K9DYJp4)
risks: Physical and in-person, so a poor fit for a time-limited async founder
UK has less curbside dumping, so free supply is less certain than in Utah
Electrical safety and liability rules for reselling appliances in the UK
Storage and transport logistics

name: Freight brokerage (franchise or independent)
one_liner: Match shippers who need goods moved with carriers and keep the spread between what the shipper pays and what the carrier charges.
customer: Businesses that need to ship goods
offer: Load matching and logistics coordination with carriers
how_it_makes_money: Spread between the shipper's price and the carrier's cost. The franchise's average franchisee does over $1M a year in revenue, but royalties are high
startup_cost: medium (franchise fee not stated; an independent route needs licensing and insurance)
evidence: "average franchisee in this business is doing over a million dollars a year in revenue" (i5vD6_QspkQ)
"they do charge one of the highest royalties that I've seen in franchising" (i5vD6_QspkQ)
risks: Figures are revenue, not profit; margins are thin and royalties are high
Sales-heavy work that needs calls and relationships
US franchise model; a UK–Portugal freight corridor would have to be built independently
Credit risk when shippers pay late

name: Garage renovation service (epoxy floors and storage)
one_liner: A home-improvement service fitting epoxy garage floors and custom slatwall storage, run as a franchise or on your own.
offer: Epoxy floor coating, custom shelving and slatwall installation
how_it_makes_money: Project fees; the average franchise unit revenue is quoted at over $1M
startup_cost: medium (franchise fee not stated; 'no heavy equipment')
time_to_first_revenue: under 30 days claimed for franchises in general
evidence: "garage renovation business... The average revenue is over a million. No heavy equipment" (i5vD6_QspkQ)
"There's clearly a ton of demand and not a lot of supply" (i5vD6_QspkQ)
risks: UK homes have fewer and smaller garages than the US, so the market is smaller
Needs on-site labour and management
The franchise's revenue claims are not independently verified

name: AI-agent setup for idle-asset rental (land/RV storage)
one_liner: Set up lead capture, pricing pages, deposit links and AI lead-qualifier agents for owners who want to rent out spare land or storage.
customer: Landowners and property owners with unused space (weak evidence: the video only shows the host's own use)
offer: Done-for-you rental funnel: CRM inquiry form, AI qualifier, Stripe deposits, Google Business Profile
how_it_makes_money: Setup fee plus a monthly retainer (not stated in the transcript; this is inferred from the business model)
evidence: Weak evidence: the host rents 40 empty acres for RV storage and uses AI agents to build the funnel; no revenue is shown (y33ecMVHxNU)
risks: No proof that customers will pay
Largely a tool demo, and the tools are easy to copy
Clients could do it themselves with the same tools
